content.title: How the Trump admin. is fueling this company's post-IPO growth
content.description:
BETA Technologies (BETA) reported quarterly results for the first time since its trading debut via an IPO in November. BETA founder and CEO Kyle Clark joins Market Domination to discuss the company's $1 billion deal to sell motors to eVTOL (Electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing) operator Eve Air Mobility, its outlook for next year, and navigating regulatory changes under the Trump administration.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
